excerpts.text:
This map shows the tallest natural point in every state, measured in feet above sea level, using data from the [USGS](https://www2.census.gov/library/publications/2011/compendia/statab/131ed/tables/12s0366.pdf) via the U.S. Census Bureau’s Statistical Abstract.

The differences are stark: Alaska rises above 20,000 feet, while several coastal states don’t even reach 1,000 feet.
